content_sections.heading: About CMO Raebareli
content_sections.text: The Office of the Chief Medical Officer is the district health office for Raebareli in Uttar Pradesh. Under the National Health Mission, U.P., it runs several programmes in the district, including NP-NCD, District Hospital Strengthening, the blood bank, telemedicine and the urban Ayushman Arogya Mandirs. This revised walk-in notice follows the Mission Director, NHM U.P., Lucknow letter no. 179/एस0पी0एम0यू0/एन0एच0एम0/डिस्ट्रिक वॉक-इन/2023-24/4150, dated 18.08.2023.

content_sections.heading: CMO Raebareli Medical Officer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: For every programme: MBBS and registration with the U.P. State Medical Council. The notice lists experience in a column headed "desired experience (if required)". The text below is as printed: NPCDCS (NP-NCD): At least 01 year of experience of working in a hospital. District Hospital Strengthening Programme: Min. 01 years experience in an emergency ward of any 100 bedded hospital preferable. Blood Bank: Preferably DCP, or one year of experience in a blood bank during regular service, plus adequate knowledge and experience of blood group serology, blood group methodology and the medical principles of procuring blood and/or preparing its components. Preference goes to candidates with a PG diploma or degree in Pathology/Transfusion Medicine. Telemedicine, Urban Ayushman Arogya Mandir (PM-ABHIM and 15th Finance) and Urban PHC: No experience is listed. For the full eligibility of each programme, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Registration and document verification on 16 November 2026, from 11:00 AM to 03:00 PM, at the Office of the Chief Medical Officer, Raebareli. Interview on 17 November 2026 from 11:00 AM, at the same office. Recruitment will follow the reservation policy of the U.P. Government. Results will be shown on the NIC website of District Raebareli and on the notice board of the CMO office, Raebareli.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The posts are purely contractual, with a fixed honorarium. A selected doctor cannot claim a permanent post. The appointment is valid for one financial year, up to 31.03.2027. It may be extended after approval from the Government of India. The number of posts and the honorarium may change at any stage of the recruitment. If any adverse fact comes to light, the interview or the contract of a selected candidate can be cancelled. No travel allowance or daily allowance is paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMO Raebareli Medical Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the Office of the Chief Medical Officer, Raebareli on 16 November 2026 between 11:00 AM and 03:00 PM. Register for the walk-in interview and have your original documents verified. Hand in one set of self-attested photocopies and one recent colour photograph. Attend the interview at the same office on 17 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. High School and Intermediate certificates MBBS certificate U.P. faq.question: Q1. Which District Hospital programme has the most Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: The District Hospital Strengthening Programme, with 8 posts (UR-04, OBC-01, SC-03), at District Hospital Male and Female, Raebareli.

faq.question: Q2. What is the performance-based incentive for the urban posts?
faq.answer: The Urban Ayushman Arogya Mandir (PM-ABHIM and 15th Finance) and Urban PHC posts pay Rs. 80,000 a month plus up to Rs. 20,000 a month as performance-based incentive.

faq.question: Q3. Do I need a PG qualification for the Blood Bank post?
faq.answer: No. A PG diploma or degree in Pathology/Transfusion Medicine only gives preference. The base requirement is MBBS with U.P. State Medical Council registration.

faq.question: Q4. What time does registration close on 16 November 2026?
faq.answer: Registration and document verification run from 11:00 AM to 03:00 PM at the CMO office, Raebareli.

faq.question: Q5. I am currently employed. What extra document do I need?
faq.answer: A No Objection Certificate from the institution where you work. You must bring it to the walk-in registration.

faq.question: Q6. How long will the contract last?
faq.answer: The appointment is valid for one financial year, up to 31.03.2027. It may be extended after approval from the Government of India.

faq.question: Q7. Where are the Urban Ayushman Arogya Mandir 15th Finance posts?
faq.answer: The 2 posts (UR-01, OBC-01) are in Lalganj and Salon Urban.

faq.question: Q8. Will travel expenses for the interview be paid?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no travel allowance is paid for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the result be published?
faq.answer: On the NIC website of District Raebareli and the notice board of the Office of the Chief Medical Officer, Raebareli.
